scope_guards: CIL and Section 106 are distinct mechanisms and are not summed into a generic parcel burden.
Potential CIL thresholds do not prove chargeable development, calculated liability, relief or payment.
Charging zones and annual rate summaries are not HMLR title or candidate geometry.
Mayoral and borough CIL date bands do not prove that a specific permission is liable.
Infrastructure Funding Statements report past activity and are not current parcel obligations.
Historic Section 106 receipts and agreements are not future commitments or discharge evidence.
Generic infrastructure need and contribution policy do not prove funded delivery.
No score or promotion is written without exact permission, liability notice or agreement, site and title evidence.
